title: A ticket crosses into BUILDME without a rehearsal
intention: A ticket crosses into BUILDME without a rehearsal record, until a learner reads the rehearsal records. The rehearsal machine, the /rehearse verb, the sieve buildme_rides_the_rehearsal and the 1,721 records stay, as that learner's first corpus.
why: Rehearsal's purpose is training data, so graph trees learn to judge 'buildable as written' without an LLM call; it was never meant to catch every shortcoming of every ticket. Nothing reads the records but this gate, so each simulation costs tokens and teaches nothing — more than CC building and recording where it got stuck. Measured 2026-11-02: 1,721 records, $888 recorded cost ($76 and 18 h model time since 10-19), ~37% clean. Akien 2026-11-02, 'agreed'; outline 17.6.
traces_to: Law 1; CP4; outline 17.6 (Akien 2026-11-02); supersedes the gate role of ticket cf80bdb57205 and the lane rename of 5f2e99bff577
how: D1: cairn/tools/base/transitions.py inspect_entry drops the lane the_ticket_was_rehearsed and the lazy import of buildme_rides_the_rehearsal (lines 977, 993-999); the comment there records the retirement and why. D2: the sieve buildme_rides_the_rehearsal in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py stays unchanged, with its direct tooth. D3: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_transitions.py (around 1513-1547) expects five lanes, the_ticket_was_rehearsed absent. D4: cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal.py tooth at 393-395 asserts the lane is absent from inspect_entry; the skill-names-the-lane tooth at 605 is re-aimed at the retirement. D5: skills/sail/SKILL.md:120 and cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json say the lane is retired until a learner reads the records. D6: the red-first proof is a new tooth in test_transitions.py: a code-seam ticket with no rehearsal record gets an entry record with no the_ticket_was_rehearsed lane. D7: after PROVED, answer open-a40b1140f1a3 as mooted.
falsifier: Done: inspect_entry returns five lanes, none the_ticket_was_rehearsed, and a ticket with no rehearsal record crosses BUILDME clean on that count; cairn/machines/rehearsal and CairnCommons/rehearsals unchanged. Wrong intent if, over the next five code-seam tickets, builds stall on plan gaps a rehearsal would have named often enough that rework costs more than rehearsals did.

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder would ask: which lane, exactly? (the_ticket_was_rehearsed, transitions.py:993-999 plus the import at 977). Do I delete the sieve? (no — keep buildme_rides_the_rehearsal and its direct tooth). Which proofs change and to what? (test_rehearsal.py tooth asserting len==6 and names[4] becomes 'five lanes, the_ticket_was_rehearsed absent'; test_transitions.py:1513-1547 lane list drops it). What about /rehearse? (untouched). The plan names each; the ticket carries everything else.
